Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Join assays on chembl_id = CHEMBL1217644, join activities on assay_id, join molecule_dictionary on molregno, and join compound_structures on molregno. Filter to exact measurements where standard_relation = '=' and standard_value IS NOT NULL and standard_relation IS NOT NULL. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
